graham.brief:
What does Minnesota do differently now that Murray is the one taking the snaps? Kyler Murray sat out week 2 and is back for week 3. The books hung Murray at 30.5 pass attempts, and he's averaged 5 all season. Murray has the job and no history.

Tampa Bay's pass defense gives up more through the air than almost anyone, 10th-worst in the league. Minnesota plays slow, 2nd-fewest plays a game. The two sides of Minnesota at Tampa Bay cancel out, and pretending otherwise would be invention.

Minnesota gives its backs almost nothing before contact, and Tampa Bay loads the box against the run. Baker Mayfield is the starter who's played 100% of the snaps.

The spread has moved a point toward Minnesota. Set the market beside it and Minnesota nearly lines up. Minnesota is favored by 1 with a 43 total. I've got the middle on Minnesota, and the books have most of it. The books have moved Jones' carry line from 18.5 to 13.5 this week. Watch whether Minnesota keeps handing off over the first two series as often as all season.
